levels.meaning: the framework layer: findings, legs, connections

levels.internet: the open internet, through the capture path

bounds.fetches: fetches requested of the capture path
bounds.wallclock: wall time across resumptions, in milliseconds
bounds.runtime: CPU or subrequest ceiling (D-54, D-56) — IS-9(d) builds its producer
bounds.mints: passages a machine credential marked citable (§7.3 (5)) — the EXTRACT role's budget
bounds.surfaces: questions an assistant opened inside this run (§11 item 5, rule 2) — the run's bound on what it may surface
bounds.proposals: options a planning run proposed for an action plan — the planning run's bound on what it may propose
bounds.pages: pages of documents the group holds that the run may read inside — the run's reading bound
bounds.lease: the run stopped heartbeating and its lease lapsed: it died rather than finished

endings.mode-not-deployed: the deployment gate refused this launch before it spent anything: the mode it asked for is not deployed yet, so no member stopped this run and no budget ran out

coverage.backed: the row names what the look produced: `result_ref` points at it, and the claim can be checked against the thing itself
coverage.none_owed: the row's state does not assert the record obtained anything, so C-22.10 requires no referent and its absence is a fact about the look rather than an unknown
